text.en: Road dust and a Rennfall seal. You'll be the Warden, then. The Marshal's clerks said to expect you.
text.id: Debu jalan dan segel Rennfall. Berarti kau sang Warden. Para juru tulis Marshal bilang kau akan datang.

text.en: Keep the blade in its sheath inside these walls. Greymarch has more laws than stones, and it enforces the expensive ones.
text.id: Simpan pedangmu di sarungnya di dalam tembok ini. Greymarch punya lebih banyak hukum daripada batu, dan yang ditegakkan selalu yang mahal.

text.en: If you are looking for the Salt League woman, she keeps to the market square. Follow the carts.
text.id: Kalau kau mencari perempuan Liga Garam, dia selalu di alun-alun pasar. Ikuti saja pedatinya.
